title: Your life deserves your attention.
criticalLine: Understand what shapes you. Transcend your culture.
loveDefinition: Love is the condition in which Fear no longer governs you.

culture.title: A society can be productive and still be lost.
culture.critique: We are immersed in assumptions long before we learn to question them. A society can call itself rational while rewarding short-term gain, confusing consumption with freedom, and measuring a person by what they produce.
culture.questions: Where does that leave the questions of consciousness, meaning, and what—if anything—lies beyond material life?
culture.challenge: What is all this progress for?
culture.loveIntro: DOT’s criticism starts here: adapting to a culture is not the same as understanding yourself. Its proposed direction is Love.
culture.reflection: The inquiry turns inward, too. The culture we question also lives in our fears, ambitions, and borrowed certainties.
